studyField: East and Southeastern European Studies (Balkan Studies)

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Because it is where my family comes from which made me interested in learning the language better and being close to my heritage

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was easy enough with the help of friends

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: We had introduction week with events

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: My classmate who I was going on exchange with had an apartment we could stay in. Have connections ;)

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: That it might be harder to become friends with serbian students

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I think we were submitted a list online where we chose which ones and sent it in an email

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: not sure actually.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Well pretty much all the classes I had chosen before were not available but I was still happy with the new ones I chose

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: To not write people emails and instead show up at their office if you're at the school anyway. That way the process will go a lot faster

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It didn't feel as hard as I thought it would be even though most of my classes were on Master level

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: This was in bigger classes which I am not used to in Cph as we are 5 students in my degree at home

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Religion and politics
Disintegration of Yugoslavia 
European Security
Skup Slavista
Serbian for foreigners

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would mostly recommend disintegration of yugoslavia for anyone interested in learning more about the history. Also I would recommend the serbian for foreigners class nor matter what level you are in the language. And I'd recommend Skup Slavista as it gives you an opportunity to explore Serbia and only have classes in Serbian

questions.answer: Clubbing and going to bars with erasmus students

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would recommend students to go and see other places. For example Bosnia and Montenegro. And also seeing other places in Serbia

questions.answer: nothing comes to mind

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: hospitality :)

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. you're gonna spend more money than you think
2. find housing that is pretty central as public transportation is shit in Belgrade
3. travel with new friends

questions.answer: not really

questions.answer: Finding new friends <3

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Public transportation
